name: ICon Festival
organizer: Israeli Society for Science Fiction & Fantasy
blurb: Israel's national annual science fiction, fantasy and tabletop RPG festival in Tel Aviv, held over Sukkot since 1998.
notes: Homepage text: 'אייקון 2026: פלאות יתקיים בחול המועד סוכות, בתאריכים 29 בספטמבר - 1 באוקטובר' (ICon 2026: Wonders, held during Sukkot, 29 Sept - 1 Oct) and 'מתקיים במרכז תל אביב' (held in central Tel Aviv, no specific venue named, so venue is left blank). That edition already ended before this research window opens (2026-10-05) -- the site's own countdown reads zero and its latest update says early-bird sales have closed -- so it is recorded as 'last' rather than guessed forward. Sukkot falls on a different Gregorian date each year on the Hebrew calendar and no 2027 date is announced yet, ticketed via the organizer's own domain (tickets.sf-f.org.il), confirming the Israeli Society for Science Fiction & Fantasy as organizer.
